title: Invitations, Requests, And Permission Open Answer
concept: Invitations, Requests, And Permission Japanese composition

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: This book is not expensive.
acceptedAnswers: この本は高くないです。
questions.explanation: くないです・ではありません: Make i-adjectives and na-adjectives negative politely.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: It was cold yesterday.
questions.explanation: かったです・でした: Describe a past state with an adjective.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: The train is faster than the bus.
acceptedAnswers: 電車はバスより速いです。
questions.explanation: A は B より adjective: Compare A with B using B as the reference point.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I like fish more than meat.
acceptedAnswers: 肉より魚のほうが好きです。
questions.explanation: A より B のほうが adjective: Say that B has more of a quality than A.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: Among fruits, I like apples best.
acceptedAnswers: 果物でりんごが一番好きです。
questions.explanation: Group + で + Noun + が一番: Identify the item with the greatest degree in a group.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I like music.
questions.explanation: Noun + が好き・嫌いです: Express likes and dislikes toward a noun or activity.
